user_request: Find least-favorite art currently in the game, present originals, revise with the current approach, compare before later art-direction codification and a new-chat test.
selection_caveat: Only IG1 and IG2 have explicit written reservations. IG3–IG8 are lowest-ranked current paintings from sparse pairwise comparisons and have earlier praise.
method_scope: This is not an isolated lighting experiment: paint simplification also changes, IG2 reduces the pressure graphic and IG7 adjusts head orientation.
live_asset_policy: No replacements or commits. Preserve all historical approvals. No general skill rule added from this experiment.
review_questions: Which complete paintings do you prefer?
Which rendering changes help, even where the original remains preferable?
Do the darker edits lose useful colour, character or card-size readability?

observations.title: Oath sentinel
observations.observation: The face, shield and armour now share a larger shadow shape. Light is concentrated on the upper-left shoulder and foliage; the ground and wall carry fewer small highlights.
observations.tradeoff: Does his face still hold enough interest at card size, or did the original's brighter finish help?

observations.title: Harmonic burst
observations.observation: The white pressure ring is gone; dust, paper and the recoiling figures suggest the disturbance. The bronze bell still hangs from its crown in the two-post frame.
observations.tradeoff: The subject and most of the staging remain the same. A rendering improvement may not change your opinion of the bell idea.

observations.title: Cinder firebrand
observations.observation: The face and chest share a darker mass, with the hottest light low on the left. Indigo sky, red cloth and orange fire remain.
observations.tradeoff: This is one of the darker revisions. Compare how readily the face and equipment read in the small preview.

observations.title: Anoint with embers
observations.observation: The faces use simpler matte planes and the eyes have smaller fire reflections. The brow contact, cast and close framing remain.
observations.tradeoff: Does the reduced surface detail feel more painted, or has it taken away too much facial character?

observations.title: Sanctuary Threshold
observations.observation: Lantern light falls off across the floor; wet-stone reflections are fewer. All three arrows, the blanket, bowl and traveller remain.
observations.tradeoff: The quieter light also makes the refuge less radiant. Judge that change separately from material quality.

observations.title: Hurled brand
observations.observation: The figure and palisade are darker against a concentrated red sunset. The throw and airborne brand remain clear.
observations.tradeoff: The silhouette is stronger, while clothing and facial detail are less visible. Decide which balance you prefer.

observations.title: Alderkin elder
observations.observation: Bark and valley detail have been grouped into larger painted areas. The existing head is turned more clearly toward the hand on the coping.
observations.tradeoff: The simpler head is more readable but may lose some of the original's strange, woody ambiguity.

observations.title: Emberward
observations.observation: Sleeves, skin and tent folds carry fewer competing accents. The brush contact and four connected hands remain; the man's gaze stays directed outside.
observations.tradeoff: The scene remains deliberately still. Judge the warmth and faces as well as the cleaner light.
